notes: Direct sync-only probe with no OPD client, teacher, or Dispatch: P2P returned success for 31643 params to one TP2 endpoint, 67.91GB in 25.37s transfer and 34.04s handler wall. The patched dummy FP8 receiver served HTTP 200 after sync and response metadata carried the new weight_version, but trivial prompts like 2+2, digit-copy, and multiplication produced token soup. Direct H100 smoke tests against patched SGLang showed dense Triton block-FP8 linear with [16,128] has plausible error versus dequantized BF16 references, and Triton fused MoE is stable for [16,128]/[32,128]/[64,128]/[128,128]; [16,128] fused MoE relative mean error was 0.012849 with cosine 0.99989. The synced full-model token soup is therefore unlikely to be an isolated dense or MoE Triton kernel bug.
